# PixelScope User Guide — agent-readable route index

Canonical authority: topic Markdown under docs/user-guide/ in this repository.
Generated site: the same pages in HTML; every route below is relative to site/llms.txt.
Local installed Help: an offline static copy; no online service or login is required.
Use the current User Guide for end-user answers. Do not substitute planned/deferred
roadmap behavior or invent an answer when a topic is missing.

Start here:
- index.html
- getting-started/installation.html
- getting-started/quick-start.html
- getting-started/concepts.html

- workflows/open-images.html
- workflows/open-folders.html
- workflows/compare-images.html
- workflows/compare-many-images.html
- workflows/curate-selection.html
- workflows/compare-folder-positions.html
- workflows/inspect-roi.html
- workflows/inspect-histogram.html
- workflows/inspect-line-profile.html
- workflows/use-difference.html
- workflows/export-analysis.html
- workflows/save-and-restore-work.html
- workflows/use-remote-iqa.html

Question routing examples:
- Compare two folders or use PageUp? -> workflows/compare-folder-positions.html
- Compare more than six images? -> workflows/compare-many-images.html
- Select an exact ROI? -> workflows/inspect-roi.html
- Open RAW14, interpret stride or offset? -> formats/raw.html
- Understand native YUV layout? -> formats/yuv.html
- Difference unavailable? -> workflows/use-difference.html and troubleshooting/index.html
- Clear a line profile? -> workflows/inspect-line-profile.html
- Understand Primary/Active? -> getting-started/concepts.html and reference/terminology.html
- Export Histogram or Difference? -> workflows/export-analysis.html
- Submit or inspect Remote IQA? -> workflows/use-remote-iqa.html

Repository-side optional agent search (not shipped with the installed Help):
- python scripts/search_user_guide.py "RAW14 stride" --json
- Searches checked-in User Guide Markdown locally; emits source path, source line,
  heading, site route and bounded excerpt. It makes no network or LLM calls.
- Use the corresponding source and cited line to verify answers in the same
  checked-out revision; links and line numbers may change across releases.

This route index is not a separate content authority or an endorsement of an
unstandardized llms-full/RAG protocol. Do not upload local image data, credentials,
internal paths, or private results to an external model to answer Help questions.
